{{Top|leg}}
'''ORS-1''' is an [[orbital relay satellite]] that served the ''[[Penga Rift]]''. The [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] broadcasted the [[Qella]] [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] in response to the ''[[Teljkon Vagabond]]'', though the vagabond destroyed it when it realized that ORS-1 was not of Qella origin. The destruction occurred over the planet of [[Brath Qella|Maltha Obex]].<ref name="Tyrant's Test">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>

*''[[Tyrant's Test]]'' {{1st}}
